description: Query Toxic Release Inventory annual chemical release data for a specific facility. Returns per-chemical release records with chemical name, reporting year, routine on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection), and the one-time / non-routine release quantity. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. TRI data lags ~18 months — the most recent available year is typically 2 years prior to the current calendar year. facility_id is the 15-character TRI facility ID: take it from the facilityId field of epa_search_tri_releases, which also identifies top emitters across a region, or from the triFacilityIds of epa_get_facility for a facility you already hold a Registry ID for. A 12-digit EPA Registry ID is a different identifier and matches no TRI records.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

facility_id.description: 15-character TRI facility ID (e.g. "9867WSNRWD1981S") — the facilityId field returned by epa_search_tri_releases, or an entry of epa_get_facility triFacilityIds. A 12-digit EPA Registry ID matches no TRI records.

year.description: Reporting year to retrieve. Omit for all available years, newest first. At most 500 filings are returned; narrow with year or chemical_name when capped. TRI data is typically available through ~2 years prior to the current year.

name: epa_get_tri_releases

cap.description: The 500-filing lookup cap, present only when reached.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: How to narrow a capped lookup with year or a more specific chemical_name.

message.description: Recovery hint when no releases are found — suggests alternative years or checking the facility ID. Absent when releases are returned.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated chemical_name filter read its page limit before finding every filing spelled as given, so more matching records may exist.

releases.description: Per-chemical annual TRI release records for the queried facility

items.description: Per-chemical TRI release record for this facility and year

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site routine air releases (fugitive + stack emissions) in pounds, summed across air release types for this submission.

releasesToLandInLbs.description: On-site routine land releases in pounds — landfills, land treatment, surface impoundment, and other on-site disposal, summed for this submission.

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site routine releases via underground injection wells in pounds, summed across injection well classes for this submission.

releasesToWaterInLbs.description: On-site routine releases to surface water in pounds, summed across all reported outfalls for this submission.

reportedUnit.description: Present as "grams" when TRI had the facility report this chemical in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); its quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent for chemicals reported in pounds.

totalReleasesInLbs.description: TRI one-time / non-routine release quantity in pounds (spills, accidents) — a distinct TRI category, NOT the sum of the per-medium routine releases below.

shown.description: Number of filings returned when capped.

truncated.description: True when 500 filings were returned and more may exist.

title: Get TRI Chemical Releases for Facility
